annotations.reason_zh: 论文研究对象是高光谱图像（HSIs），并围绕其分类任务展开，满足高光谱图像应用对象定义。

annotations.exact_quote: an adaptive sparse representation algorithm is introduced to obtain the sparse coefficients
annotations.reason_zh: 提出自适应稀疏表示算法获取稀疏系数并用于分类，核心机制是通过稀疏表示表达样本，满足稀疏表示定义。

annotations.exact_quote: First, four different features are separately extracted from the original HSI and they reflect different kinds of spectral and spatial information. Second, for each pixel, a shape adaptive (SA) spatial region is extracted. Third, an adaptive sparse representation algorithm is introduced to obtain the sparse coefficients for the multiple-feature matrix set of pixels in each SA region. Finally, these obtained coefficients are jointly used to determine the class label of each test pixel.
annotations.reason_zh: 从同一HSI提取四种互补的谱/空特征，构造多特征矩阵集并联合判定类别，显式联合利用多个特征视图，满足多视图学习设定。
